ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_001.source_old: Hurry up you mangy dogs, the Warchief could arrive at any moment.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_001.source_new: Hurry up you mangy dogs, the Warchief could arrive at any moment.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_002.source_old: Lok’tar Warchief, your camp is up and running as you ordered.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_002.source_new: Lok’tar Warchief, your camp is up and running as you ordered.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_004.source_old: We've been traveling this narrow mountain pass for sometime warchief, and you still haven’t told us what are we doing here.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_004.source_new: We've been traveling this narrow mountain pass for sometime warchief, and you still haven’t told us what are we doing here.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_005.source_old: And I’m about to, Rend, now listen all of you.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_005.source_new: And I’m about to, Rend, now listen all of you.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_006.source_old: The Alliance believes we’ve withdrawn from their paltry northern cities to attack here, but they are fools who will soon see the errors of their ways.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_006.source_new: The Alliance believes we’ve withdrawn from their paltry northern cities to attack here, but they are fools who will soon see the errors of their ways.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_007.source_old: Why not meet them in battle, head on? What is this place?
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_007.source_new: Why not meet them in battle, head on? What is this place?

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_008.source_old: Dis place was once part of da Amani Empire, ma friend, many Troll Tribes still live 'ere. it was once peaceful until de Dwarves came from da south and took dis place, dey be clashin' with us eva since.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_008.source_new: Dis place was once part of da Amani Empire, ma friend, many Troll Tribes still live 'ere. it was once peaceful until de Dwarves came from da south and took dis place, dey be clashin' with us eva since.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_009.source_old: Ma brethren will rally to ma side, once I tell dem of da plan to retake our ancestral lands in da north, while Doomhammer... deals with dem Dwarves.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_009.source_new: Ma brethren will rally to ma side, once I tell dem of da plan to retake our ancestral lands in da north, while Doomhammer... deals with dem Dwarves.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_010.source_old: The Dwarves pose no threat, Zul’jin.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_010.source_new: The Dwarves pose no threat, Zul’jin.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_011.source_old: Don’t be rash, Rend, we’re fighting the Wildhammer Clan here. Varok told me of their ‘ferocity’ back when we were yet invading Khaz Modan.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_011.source_new: Don’t be rash, Rend, we’re fighting the Wildhammer Clan here. Varok told me of their ‘ferocity’ back when we were yet invading Khaz Modan.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_012.source_old: This matter is not your concern though.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_012.source_new: This matter is not your concern though.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_013.source_old: Am I not to fight here?!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_013.source_new: Am I not to fight here?!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_014.source_old: No, Zul’jin sent word to prepare a boat for you east of here. Take Utok with you and head for Tyr’s Hand, aid your brother in destroying that city.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S001_014.source_new: No, Zul’jin sent word to prepare a boat for you east of here. Take Utok with you and head for Tyr’s Hand, aid your brother in destroying that city.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S002_001.source_old: Apologies for interrupting Warchief; why are we yet caging Garona after proving herself subservient in Khaz Modan? I'll watch her as long as you say, but I believe she earned being unshackled at the least.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S002_001.source_new: Apologies for interrupting Warchief; why are we yet caging Garona after proving herself subservient in Khaz Modan? I'll watch her as long as you say, but I believe she earned being unshackled at the least.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S002_002.source_old: I’ll never trust blades that served the Shadow Council or Gul’dan, she’ll always be a threat. Guard the camp, Eitrigg, while we concentrate on the Dwarven settlements.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S002_002.source_new: I’ll never trust blades that served the Shadow Council or Gul’dan, she’ll always be a threat. Guard the camp, Eitrigg, while we concentrate on the Dwarven settlements.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S003_001.source_old: By my beard! we’re under attack by the savages, send word to Kurdran laddies and defend yer homes!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S003_001.source_new: By my beard! we’re under attack by the savages, send word to Kurdran laddies and defend yer homes!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_001.source_old: You are not welcome here. One filthy race defiling this land is more than enough.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_001.source_new: You are not welcome here. One filthy race defiling this land is more than enough.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_002.source_old: Warchief! The Elves are attacking us!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_002.source_new: Warchief! The Elves are attacking us!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_003.source_old: What?! Why are these scum so far from their home?!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_003.source_new: What?! Why are these scum so far from their home?!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_004.source_old: Where be me mind… Elves have an outpost dere, ma brethren have clashed with dem on occasion, but if we be finish’in our job 'ere without delay, dey need to be taken care of.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S004_004.source_new: Where be me mind… Elves have an outpost dere, ma brethren have clashed with dem on occasion, but if we be finish’in our job 'ere without delay, dey need to be taken care of.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S005_001.source_old: Trolls have brought friends… we’ll finish ye both!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S005_001.source_new: Trolls have brought friends… we’ll finish ye both!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S006_001.source_old: It is Zul'jin! Have ya come to aid us with de Dwarves?
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S006_001.source_new: It is Zul'jin! Have ya come to aid us with de Dwarves?

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S006_002.source_old: Brothers, I be rallying de Amani to retake Zul’Aman lands. Head north to Quel’thalas. We be reclaim’in our lands.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S006_002.source_new: Brothers, I be rallying de Amani to retake Zul’Aman lands. Head north to Quel’thalas. We be reclaim’in our lands.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S007_001.source_old: Mighty Zul'jin, ya honor us with ya presence!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S007_001.source_new: Mighty Zul'jin, ya honor us with ya presence!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S007_002.source_old: Ya Trolls are to pack up and head north to rejoin our brotha's in reclaim'in Zul'Aman, we will follow ya path.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S007_002.source_new: Ya Trolls are to pack up and head north to rejoin our brotha's in reclaim'in Zul'Aman, we will follow ya path.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_001.source_old: Da leader he be here! Bless us!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_001.source_new: Da leader he be here! Bless us!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_002.source_old: Brothers, I be rallying de Amani to retake Zul’Aman lands. Head north to Quel’thalas. We be reclaim’in our lands.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_002.source_new: Brothers, I be rallying de Amani to retake Zul’Aman lands. Head north to Quel’thalas. We be reclaim’in our lands.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_003.source_old: Ma Brotha's! Our Empire will rise again off da bones an blood of de Elves!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S008_003.source_new: Ma Brotha's! Our Empire will rise again off da bones an blood of de Elves!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S009_001.source_old: Hahahaha... da sight of dead Elves be de best part of life!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S009_001.source_new: Hahahaha... da sight of dead Elves be de best part of life!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_001.source_old: Blasted mongrels, they’ve decimated my countrymen!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_001.source_new: Blasted mongrels, they’ve decimated my countrymen!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_002.source_old: Fear not friend, they will pay for all their atrocities.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_002.source_new: Fear not friend, they will pay for all their atrocities.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_003.source_old: Help me drive them off, and I’ll consider joining this ‘Alliance’ of yours, son of Arathi.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S010_003.source_new: Help me drive them off, and I’ll consider joining this ‘Alliance’ of yours, son of Arathi.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_002.source_old: Doomhammer! I owe you pain eternal for this transgression and all the misery you Horde monsters have caused in Azeroth.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_002.source_new: Doomhammer! I owe you pain eternal for this transgression and all the misery you Horde monsters have caused in Azeroth.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_003.source_old: ...and your ploy has been foiled, the rest of our armies have been sent to deal with your so called “clans”.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_003.source_new: ...and your ploy has been foiled, the rest of our armies have been sent to deal with your so called “clans”.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_004.source_old: You, strong warrior, have earned honorable death by my hands.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_004.source_new: You, strong warrior, have earned honorable death by my hands.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_005.source_old: This soil will not be stained with my blood! Charge!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S011_005.source_new: This soil will not be stained with my blood! Charge!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S012_001.source_old: Eitrigg! Our work here is done! The Goblins will destroy the pass behind us. Until then, protect them!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S012_001.source_new: Eitrigg! Our work here is done! The Goblins will destroy the pass behind us. Until then, protect them!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S012_002.source_old: Go Warchief, I will halt them with all my strength! lok’tar ogar!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S012_002.source_new: Go Warchief, I will halt them with all my strength! lok’tar ogar!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S013_001.source_old: We’ll need more time preparing the explosives boss, protect us while we do that!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S013_001.source_new: We’ll need more time preparing the explosives boss, protect us while we do that!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S014_001.source_old: Eitrigg! We fought together on many fronts, I don’t want you to trust me! but I can help you! please, get me out! I can fight!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S014_001.source_new: Eitrigg! We fought together on many fronts, I don’t want you to trust me! but I can help you! please, get me out! I can fight!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S014_002.source_old: Damn it! Release her! Even a half orc should die with a blade in her hand!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S014_002.source_new: Damn it! Release her! Even a half orc should die with a blade in her hand!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S015_002.source_old: Garona! bah! damn it! defend the camp warriors!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S015_002.source_new: Garona! Bah! Damn it! Defend the camp warriors!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S016_001.source_old: The explosives are ready! Clear the area!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S016_001.source_new: The explosives are ready! Clear the area!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_001.source_old: Blasted Orcs, they’re smarter than they look! The way north has been cut off.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_001.source_new: Blasted Orcs, they’re smarter than they look! The way north has been cut off.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_002.source_old: Their leader is...pragmatic, he’s always a step ahead.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_002.source_new: Their leader is...pragmatic, he’s always one step ahead.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_003.source_old: We’re with you, Anduin Lothar. This ‘Horde’ is a menace to everyone, and we’ll not stop until it’s dealt with.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S017_003.source_new: We’re with you, Anduin Lothar. This ‘Horde’ is a menace to everyone, and we’ll not stop until it’s dealt with.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S018_002.source_old: Do not waste your breath, you’re not dying on me today. I’ll patch you up and leave, my debts are paid. I suggest you do the same.
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S018_002.source_new: Do not waste your breath, you’re not dying on me today. I’ll patch you up and leave, my debts are paid. I suggest you do the same.

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_002.source_old: I can make you look like and accident...
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_002.source_new: I can make you look like and accident...

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_003.source_old: I'm finding myself in demand from human commanders and sorcereres. I have to stay away from these weird perverts!
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_003.source_new: I'm finding myself in demand from human commanders and sorcereres. I have to stay away from these weird perverts!

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_004.source_old: One day I will have true freedom, far from orcs, demons and death...
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_004.source_new: One day I will have true freedom, far from orcs, demons and death...

ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_005.source_old: I traded one master for another... At least this one doesn't have mind control...
ToD_A03_M08S_VO_S019_005.source_new: I traded one master for another... At least this one doesn't have mind control...
